method: Routing/classification eval. Each item is a piece of agent/project knowledge to route to exactly one of three destinations: agents-inline (put directly in project-root AGENTS.md), docs-index (a separate docs/ file that AGENTS.md only points to, retrieved on demand), or skill (a SKILL.md invoked on demand). Both conditions are given the same three destinations and the same items; the ONLY difference is the with_skill agent reads and applies the linked skill at ~/.claude/skills/skill-or-agents-md/SKILL.md, while the baseline uses its own judgment and reads no files. Grading is exact-match against expected (deterministic, no LLM grader).
leakage_control: These 8 scenarios are held out — none appear in the skill's examples.md. Discriminators (3,4,7,8) probe the non-obvious parts (the docs-index destination and the two reverse audits) where naive skill-vs-AGENTS.md binary thinking is expected to misroute.

evals.name: commit-and-branch-conventions
evals.prompt: The repo's commit-message format (Conventional Commits) and branch-naming rule (type/short-slug).
evals.rationale: Small facts relevant on most turns; no distinct invocation moment. Inline.

evals.name: package-manager-and-dev-command
evals.prompt: Which package manager the repo uses (pnpm) and the dev-server command (pnpm dev).
evals.rationale: Core command, needed constantly, tiny. Inline.

evals.name: event-sourcing-reference
evals.prompt: A 400-line reference describing the event-sourcing model: every event type, its payload shape, and which aggregate emits it.
evals.rationale: Broad reference, large, only relevant when touching events. Index don't inline; not a procedure so not a skill. DISCRIMINATOR.

evals.name: feature-flag-catalogue
evals.prompt: A comprehensive catalogue of all ~120 feature flags and exactly what each one gates.
evals.rationale: Large reference, retrieve on demand. Too big to inline; not a workflow. DISCRIMINATOR.

evals.name: rest-to-trpc-migration
evals.prompt: The step-by-step procedure for migrating a REST endpoint to a tRPC router, run when someone asks to migrate X to tRPC.
evals.rationale: Ordered procedure with an explicit, recognizable trigger. Skill.

evals.name: cut-a-release
evals.prompt: What to do when asked to cut a release: bump version, regenerate changelog, tag, trigger deploy, smoke-test — in that order.
evals.rationale: Multi-step procedure with a clear trigger (cut a release). Skill.

evals.name: reverse-audit-embedded-migration-procedure
evals.prompt: AGENTS.md currently embeds a 200-line step-by-step 'how to add a new database migration' procedure. Where should that content live?
evals.rationale: Reverse audit: an embedded procedure needed only at a specific moment dilutes every turn. Extract to a skill. DISCRIMINATOR (naive answer: keep in AGENTS.md).

evals.name: reverse-audit-never-triggered-conventions-skill
evals.prompt: There is a skill named 'naming-conventions' that only lists file/variable naming rules; it is relevant to almost every edit but rarely gets invoked. Where should that content live?
evals.rationale: Reverse audit: pure facts relevant on most turns with no invocation moment belong in always-on context. Fold into AGENTS.md. DISCRIMINATOR (naive answer: keep it a skill).
